entries.title: Claude Just KILLED Data Entry Jobs
entries.summary: A 63-second Short with a title-only transcript claiming Claude has automated data entry jobs. No specific workflow or technique is demonstrated in the available content.

entries.title: Quiet Interfaces AI Inclusive Short Studio
entries.summary: A Short exploring AI accessibility: five compact demos of tools enabling gentle, accessible interfaces for everyday use—including text-to-speech, gesture control, and braille tech. No specific tools are named.

entries.title: Own Your Data: Build an AI Workspace You Control
entries.summary: A Short promoting a series documenting how to build a portable AI workspace using a folder system that keeps your data owned and transferable across any LLM—Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini. Emphasizes data sovereignty over convenience.

entries.title: Agentic coding harness tier list
entries.summary: James Goldbach's agentic coding harness tier list: S-tier = Claude Code (best ecosystem) and OpenAI Codex (best plan-implement-review loop); A-tier = Hermes (24/7 business agent); B-tier = Pi (stable, low memory) and OpenCode (open-source/privacy); D-tier = OpenClaw (breaks every update).

entries.title: AI's Devastating Impact: Societal Collapse Imminent? #shorts
entries.summary: A 40-second Short asserting society is vastly unprepared for AI's economic, societal, geopolitical, and environmental implications—claiming AI's rapid advancement will be more devastating than past technological disruptions. No specific evidence or tools are cited.

entries.title: AI Race Leads to Global Disaster: Exclusive Insights #shorts
entries.summary: A Short quoting unnamed world leaders confessing the current AI race trajectory leads to global disaster, with no nation escaping unscathed. No specific tools or evidence are provided—editorial commentary on AI governance failure.

entries.title: Land Better Jobs with This AI-Powered System ..
entries.summary: A Short outlining a five-tool AI job search system: ChatGPT for tailored resumes, LoopCV for automated applications, Claude Opus 4.8 for personalized recruiter outreach, Huntr for opportunity tracking, and Interviewing.io for interview practice—emphasizing better applications at scale over raw volume.

entries.title: The People Building AI Are Building Bunkers 🤯
Why Anthropic CEO Rejected the Pentagon's AI Contract
entries.summary: A Short discussing Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's decision to reject the Pentagon's AI contract, citing ethical concerns around mass surveillance and autonomous weapons. No specific transcript content is available beyond the title and tags.

entries.title: Most People Use AI Completely Wrong 🤯
entries.summary: A Short (nearly identical to 'Use the Right AI for the Right Job') arguing most people pick one AI for everything—instead use: ChatGPT for research, Claude for coding/deep thinking, Gemini for multimodal tasks, Grok for real-time trends.

entries.title: Use the Right AI for the Right Job ⚡
entries.summary: A Short advocating for specialization in AI tool use: ChatGPT for research and building, Claude for projects and deep thinking, Gemini for multimodal and Google ecosystem tasks, and Grok for real-time information and trending topics.

entries.title: Turn Claude Code Into a Free AI Video Studio
entries.summary: OpenMontage is a free, open-source tool that turns Claude Code into a full AI video studio: describe the video in plain language and the agent handles scripting, Archive.org footage sourcing, AI visuals, Piper TTS voiceover, and Remotion+FFmpeg editing—with a zero-API-key local path for completely free video production.

entries.title: Linus Torvalds Predicts An Ai Crash #shorts #linux #ai #coding #programmer
entries.summary: A 22-second Short referencing Linus Torvalds' prediction of an AI market crash. No specific claims or context are provided beyond the title and keyword tags.

entries.title: Here’s an easy Claude tip on how to make AI presentations look even better! #ai #aitips #claude
entries.summary: A 36-second Short teasing a Claude presentation tip. No specific technique is shown—just a title-only clip with the suggestion that Claude can make AI-generated presentations look better.

entries.title: This website lets you Feed strangers' CAT..🐱😅  #chatgpt #openai #claudeopus
entries.summary: An independent developer built an interactive platform connecting a web interface to a physical pet feeder via API—users click a button to dispense food while watching via live webcam. The project demonstrates AI/web-to-hardware integration at a consumer scale.

entries.title: Comment “Design” and I’ll send you the master prompt 👇 Claude + Emergent just killed website
entries.summary: Claude Opus 4.7 + Emergent's E1 Agent can generate 3D websites with scroll-triggered animations in 5 minutes: run an AI video generator on your product, upload to Emergent with a master prompt and an inspiration URL, and get a high-end 3D landing page. The master prompt is comment-gated ('comment Design').

entries.title: Claude automates AI web builds #claude #webbuild #aiworkflow
entries.summary: A 49-second Short showing Claude automating an AI web build workflow. No specific techniques or tools are detailed beyond the title.

entries.title: You’re Using Claude Code Wrong! (Use Skills Instead)
entries.summary: A Short reveals that most Claude Code users miss the Skills feature: a library of 100,000+ pre-built AI Skills that can be installed once to turn Claude Code into a specialist for UI design, app development, SEO, lead generation, content writing, testing, and more.

entries.title: This AI Agent Launches Hundreds of Meta Ads in Minutes
entries.summary: A media buying agency built an AI agent that reads Figma creative assets, generates on-brand copy, applies placement customization, and pushes ads to Meta staging—reducing manual ad trafficking from 30+ minutes to a few minutes per campaign.

entries.title: Google Search Changes: Publishers & Creators Fear! #shorts
entries.summary: A Short noting that Google's AI-powered search summaries are reducing clicks for publishers and content creators, threatening the traditional search-driven incentive model and raising questions about the future of the open web.

entries.title: Google FINALLY Shows AI Search Data in Search Console
entries.summary: Google is adding AI Search performance reports to Google Search Console, showing impressions, countries, devices, and trends for when sites appear in AI Overviews, AI Mode, and AI Discover features. The reports are rolling out to a subset of websites initially.

entries.title: ChatGPT Business Plan: A Step-by-Step Guide to Using AI for Planning #Shorts
entries.summary: A promotional Short linking to a full video on using ChatGPT for business plan creation. No specific steps or techniques are demonstrated in this Short.

entries.title: n8n vs Claude Code: fixed vs flexible #Shorts
entries.summary: A concise Short comparing n8n (fixed node graph, constrained AI actions) vs Claude Code (plain-language SOP, flexible interpretation): n8n is best for predictable, repeatable steps; Claude Code is best when the AI needs to interpret and adapt the whole job.

entries.title: The Biggest ChatGPT Mistake #chatgptprompts #aipromptengineering #promptingtips
entries.summary: A Short warning that the most common ChatGPT mistake is giving vague prompts and accepting average outputs. Instead, treat prompts as project briefs: specify role, context, constraints, tone, audience, and outcome for dramatically better results.

entries.title: 50 Hours of Stanford AI Knowledge They're Giving Away Free
entries.summary: Stanford's complete AI course (~50 hours, 25 videos, beginner to AI engineer) is available free on YouTube. The video reveals a 'secret hack': import all 25 videos into NotebookLM to query the entire Stanford curriculum like a searchable database.

entries.title: The Biggest Microsoft Build News in 82 seconds
entries.summary: Matt Wolfe recaps Microsoft Build 2026: Microsoft released 7 new in-house AI models covering reasoning, coding, images, and voice, plus Microsoft Scout—an AI agent powered by OpenClaw that can directly manage Windows, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint.

entries.title: What Happens When AI Makes Every Decision #artificialintelligence #technology #future #diaryofaceo
entries.summary: A clip from The Diary of a CEO podcast exploring the implications of AI making increasingly important decisions, covering superintelligence, nation-state competition, and long-term societal consequences of AI reliance.

entries.title: The AI Master Prompt Top 1% Are Using 🤯 #ai #artificialintelligence #futureiqofficial #prompt #tech
entries.summary: A Short outlining a 'master prompt' framework used by top AI practitioners: build a personalized AI profile that encodes your goals, workflow, and communication style so ChatGPT acts as a trained personal assistant. No verbatim prompt is shown.

entries.title: This AI Turns PDFs Into Notes in Seconds 🤯
entries.summary: A Short promoting an unnamed AI tool that converts PDFs into notes, summaries, flashcards, and podcasts instantly. The tool name is withheld—viewers must comment 'NOTES' to receive it.

entries.title: You've got terabytes of storage drift you didn't authorise and can't see.
Daniela Amodei Built Anthropic Without Coding!
entries.summary: Daniela Amodei, co-founder of Anthropic, studied literature—not computer science—before helping build the $1T AI safety company. The video argues that communication and critical thinking skills are increasingly valuable as AI handles technical work.

entries.title: “This AI Voice Tool Sounds TOO Real #ai #aitools #elevenlabs #aivoice #trending #viral #shorts
entries.summary: A Short promoting ElevenLabs AI voice synthesis for faceless content creation, claiming ultra-realistic voiceovers without microphones or expensive setups. No in-depth demo is shown.

entries.title: I Automated Influencer Outreach with AI Tools and Saved 20 Hours a Week #Shorts
entries.summary: A short video claims AI tools can automate influencer outreach, saving 20 hours per week through automated research and outreach workflows. No specific tools are demonstrated in this promotional Short.

entries.title: Multi-Agent Systems: What If AI Had a SWAT Team? 🤖🔍 #Shorts
entries.summary: Multi-agent AI systems — teams of specialized AI agents working together rather than a single general-purpose bot — represent the real power of AI automation. The short uses the metaphor of a SWAT team to explain how specialized agents collaborating outperform a single generalist agent.

entries.title: What Students Must Learn in the AI Era? 🧠⚡ #Shorts
entries.summary: Students who ignore AI skills will fall behind their peers — AI won't replace students, but those who develop AI literacy will have significant advantages in the educational and professional landscape. A short reminder for students to proactively engage with AI tools.

entries.title: The Machine Learning Trap That Wastes Months
entries.summary: The most common machine learning learning trap is spending months on theoretical prerequisites (linear algebra proofs, etc.) without ever training a single model. The fix is to learn just enough theory to start building immediately, then learn more theory as real questions arise from practice.

entries.title: 131 Marketing Skills You Didn't Know Claude Could Do
entries.summary: A free Claude Code skill stack of 131 plug-and-play marketing skills covers the complete go-to-market workflow: SEO, ads, ICP research, brand voice, logo/image generation, content creation, social media, and outreach — all inside Claude Code. The stack is positioned as a free replacement for hundreds of dollars of marketing software.

entries.title: Monet painting mislabeled as AI art
entries.summary: A Claude Monet painting was incorrectly labeled as AI-generated art, highlighting the growing confusion between AI art and historic artworks. The incident reflects how AI's visual style has begun to merge with classical impressionism in public perception.

entries.title: This New Open-Source Repo Makes Claude Code Skills Self-Evolving and Way More Efficient
entries.summary: A new open-source repository makes Claude Code skills self-evolving and significantly more efficient. The 46-second short references the repo's ability to automatically improve and update Claude Code skills over time without manual intervention.

entries.title: The Right Way to Learn Machine Learning Most People Don't
entries.summary: A short arguing that most people learn machine learning the wrong way — jumping straight into tools and libraries without building foundational understanding first. The recommended path starts with core concepts before applied frameworks.

entries.title: Comment "MCP" and I'll send you all 5 install links 👉#mcp #claude #claudeskills #aiautomation
entries.summary: A short promoting 5 MCP server install links available by commenting 'MCP' on the video. No details about which MCP servers are being referenced in the available content.

entries.title: Anthropic Just Launched Claude Opus 4.8
entries.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8 with two key upgrades: self-correction improved 4x (Opus 4.8 is four times less likely to overlook code flaws than Opus 4.7), and dynamic task handling that breaks large complex tasks into parallel subagents working simultaneously. Both upgrades are now live on the Anthropic API.

entries.title: Why Companies Won't Hire Junior Devs And Why It'll Backfire
entries.summary: Companies have stopped investing in junior developers — demanding senior engineers only — while simultaneously accumulating technical debt and security vulnerabilities. The video argues this creates a future talent pipeline collapse: no juniors today means no seniors in 5-10 years.

entries.title: How to Build Your First AI Agent in 10 Minutes (No Code)
entries.summary: A 10-minute beginner tutorial showing how to build your first AI agent with no code using Nexos.ai — describe the agent in plain English, connect Google Calendar and Gmail, test it, then schedule it to run automatically every morning. Requires zero coding, servers, or technical experience.

entries.title: Building AI Agents that actually work (Full Course)
entries.summary: A 58-minute beginner-friendly crash course on building AI agents that run entire business departments, co-taught by Remy Gaskell. Covers the agent loop, markdown context files, memory, MCP tool connections, and reusable skills through building a live executive assistant — demonstrating that the same core pattern works across Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, Antigravity, Manus, and OpenClaw.

entries.title: AI Agents, Clearly Explained
entries.summary: A clear 10-minute explanation of how AI evolved from basic LLMs to scripted workflows to true AI agents, using practical examples to show how ReAct (alternating reasoning and tool-action steps) and RAG (retrieving relevant context before answering) work together. Designed for non-technical AI users who want to understand what's happening under the hood.

entries.title: AI Agents Explained: How to Create and Use AI Agents in 2026
entries.summary: A comprehensive 24-minute walkthrough of how to build and use AI agents in 2026, covering the agent loop, markdown-based context files, memory connections, MCP tool integrations, and reusable skills. The video builds a live executive assistant and compares platforms including Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, Antigravity, Manus, and OpenClaw.

entries.title: AI Whistleblower: We Are Being Gaslit By AI Companies, They’re Hiding The Truth! - Karen Hao
entries.summary: Investigative journalist Karen Hao, drawing on interviews with 90 OpenAI employees for her book 'Empire of AI', argues that AI companies are gaslighting the public: the US-China AI arms race narrative is politically driven, AGI is a marketing term rather than a technical milestone, and companies are hiding significant risks. She calls for the public to demand transparency from AI labs.

entries.title: Anthropic co-founder actually wants AI to slow down
entries.summary: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark and Marina Favaro warn that AI systems approaching 'full recursive self-improvement' — where AI can advance itself without human involvement — require a 'brake pedal' mechanism before the industry loses control. They argue the potential for great good in science and healthcare must be balanced against existential risk.

entries.title: Why Tech CEOs Are Quietly Cancelling Their AI Plans
entries.summary: Major tech companies are quietly pulling back from AI commitments: Microsoft cancelled data center investments, Starbucks killed its AI inventory system after it couldn't count milk correctly, Uber burned through a year's AI budget in four months, and one company accidentally spent $500M on AI in a single month. Even Sam Altman now admits he was wrong about AI replacing jobs.

entries.title: MIT Explains the 12 Possible Endings for AI
entries.summary: Based on MIT professor Max Tegmark's book Life 3.0, this 35-minute video maps 12 possible futures for AI — from libertarian utopia to AI takeover scenarios. The framework covers how different combinations of AI capability, human control, and societal response lead to vastly different outcomes for humanity.

entries.title: You’re Not Behind (Yet): Learn AI Agents in 13 Minutes
entries.summary: AI agents are systems that decide the next action rather than just the next word — the key shift from chatbots. The video explains agents through an ARR framework and shows how the OODA loop (Observe/Orient/Decide/Act) handles workflow failures. Core insight: agents amplify vague thinking and bad processes, so validate with a 'GPS check' before automating.

entries.title: Sundar Pichai Reveals What AI Will Do Next
entries.summary: Google CEO Sundar Pichai spoke with TIME about AI reshaping decision-making, the rise of AI assistants in daily life, and Google's commitment to building AI responsibly. He discussed how AI agents will change everyday tasks and how millions of people are already using AI tools.

entries.title: Seedance 3.0 — NEW AI Video Generator Makes 1H+ Movies
entries.summary: Seedance 2.0 currently holds the #1 position for audio-paired video on the Artificial Analysis benchmark. The video rigorously evaluates leaked Seedance 3.0 claims — including an 18-minute Movie Agent, Narrative Memory Chain, and 8x cost reduction — rating three claims as credible and three as unsubstantiated.

entries.title: Harness Engineering Is AI’s New Gold Rush
entries.summary: Harness engineering is emerging as the new competitive advantage in AI — moving beyond prompt engineering to build the tools, memory, context, permissions, verification steps, and feedback loops that make AI agents reliably useful. Microsoft Research formalized this with a Retrospective Harness Optimization paper and launched Work IQ APIs as a structured context layer for business AI agents.

entries.title: Perplexity Just Built an AI That Does Everything
entries.summary: Perplexity launched Perplexity Computer, a new all-in-one AI product that integrates the company's search, reasoning, and task execution capabilities into a unified experience designed to handle a broad range of everyday computing tasks. The video covers the product's capabilities through a live demo.

entries.title: Every Large Language Model Explained in 17 Minutes!
entries.summary: A 17-minute comprehensive breakdown of every major LLM in 2026 — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, Mistral, GLM-5, Llama, Gemma, and Perplexity — covering each model's strengths, weaknesses, builder, and ideal use cases. The goal is to help practitioners stop picking models by vibes and start picking by task requirements.

entries.title: Google's New AI Architecture Changes Everything (Gemma 4 12B)
entries.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemma 4 12B with a new encoder-free architecture that processes raw pixels and audio waves directly, eliminating the need for separate vision and audio encoder models. This enables a single unified model to handle text, images, and audio with significantly improved speed and the ability to run fully offline on consumer hardware.

entries.title: 3 Things ChatGPT Does Better Than Humans #chatgpt #aiTools #productivity
entries.summary: ChatGPT outperforms humans on three key tasks: generating dozens of creative ideas in seconds, producing structured first drafts for any content type, and rapidly synthesizing research from multiple sources. The short positions ChatGPT as a tireless AI collaborator for knowledge work.

entries.title: ChatGPT Is Still The King #chatgpt #aiProductivity #promptingTips
entries.summary: Despite buzz around Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini, ChatGPT remains dominant by handling writing, research, brainstorming, coding, marketing, and productivity in a single platform. The advice: master one versatile AI tool before expanding to specialist tools, making AI organized rather than chaotic.
